meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能控制浏览器替你完成网页操作：打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据等。它会分步执行，并在多次操作间保留页面状态，方便连续处理任务。
howto.when: 当你说“打开某网址”“点击”“填表”等指令，或提出任何与浏览器相关的操作请求时触发。

say.note: Claude会访问该网址并保存截图。

say.text: 在 example.com 搜索“天气”，然后点击搜索按钮。
say.note: Claude会打开网页，定位搜索框输入并点击按钮。

say.text: 抓取 example.com 首页的所有文章标题，列给我。
say.note: Claude会读取页面内容，提取并列出文章标题。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can control a browser to perform web tasks: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, etc. It works in small steps and keeps page state between actions, allowing multi-step workflows to continue.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user says something like 'open a URL', 'click on', 'fill out the form', or makes any browser interaction request.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude visits the URL and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Search 'weather' on example.com and click the search button.
say_en.note: Claude finds the input, types, and clicks.

say_en.text: Scrape all article titles from example.com and list them.
say_en.note: Claude reads the page and returns the titles.
